units.source_text: 信辅对这种贫穷有深深的憎恨。

en.t: Shinsuke felt a deep hatred for this poverty.

units.source_text: 不，直到现在这种憎恨还留在他心里未曾消散。

en.t: No, even now this hatred still remained in his heart and had not faded away.

units.source_text: 我没钱买书，没钱参加暑期学校，没钱买新大衣。

en.t: I had no money to buy books, no money to attend summer school, and no money to buy a new overcoat.

units.source_text: 但是他的同学们都拥有这一切。

en.t: But his classmates all had these things.

units.source_text: 他羡慕他们，偶尔还会嫉妒他们。

en.t: He envied them, and at times he even felt jealous of them.

units.source_text: 但是，他肯定不会承认这种羡慕和嫉妒的，因为他瞧不起那些没本事的同学。

en.t: But he would certainly never admit to this envy and jealousy, because he looked down on those incompetent classmates.
